title: 7 Whether anie one maie bee ſaued out of the Church.

segments.text: NO man can bee ſaued out of the Church: For whomſoeuer God hath choſen and elected to the ende, which is eternal life, them he hath choſen to the means, which is the inward and outwarde calling. Obiection. Therefore Election is not free. Aunſwere. It is free; becauſe God choſe freely, both to the end, and to the meanes. But after he hath once deſtined and ordeined men to meanes, hee neuer changeth: Wee are here alſo to holde againſt the Anabaptiſtes, That infantes, which are borne in the church, are alſo of the church.
